projects.title: Learning from curricular paths
projects.summary: Exploring spatiotemporal graph neural networks to classify academic paths and identify courses associated with graduation delays. The work connects student histories with questions about academic progression; improved graduation outcomes have not been established.

projects.title: Reconstructing images from projections
projects.summary: Adapted a Julia example to reconstruct images from line integrals, simulating X-ray tomography. Compared optimization methods and examined how each affected reconstruction quality, linking mathematical formulations to visible changes in the resulting images.

projects.title: PensumEditor
projects.summary: Built a graphical editor in Java and JavaFX for personalized university study plans. Students can select courses, arrange their sequence, and visualize a curricular path, making the relationships between course choices easier to explore.

research.title: Training morphological neural networks
research.summary: Investigated optimization in Supremum-of-Erosions networks for image transformations. Compared single- and two-branch architectures, initialization strategies, and dataset sizes, using noisy FashionMNIST images to study convergence and the structure of learned operators.
